description:
Yeongi, a sweet but clueless intern, is just trying to survive office life when he catches the eye of Bom, a fellow intern with a bold heart and zero chill. She's awkward, she's intense, and she's completely smitten—and she's not exactly subtle about it. From clumsy lunch invitations to over-the-top compliments, Bom launches a full-on (and very adorable) pursuit of Yeongi’s heart, much to the confusion of… well, everyone. Enter Yoonbin, the ever-serious team leader who accidentally catches a glimpse of their budding romance—and suddenly finds himself caught in the middle of a bizarre love comedy he never asked to star in. As misunderstandings pile up and office gossip spreads faster than a group chat, one thing’s for sure: This spring, love is in the air… but professionalism? Not so much. Is this the start of Yeongi’s first romance—or just another workplace disaster?

(Source: Lezhin US)
